objective: Implement and test the game's Linux 3D arena rendering and camera, following the validated design.
completion_contract: Prerequisite: the design and engine feasibility evidence have been independently accepted. Outcome: a legible real-time 3D arena with depth, lighting or equivalent depth cues, visible ground contact, and a camera that keeps action and airborne debris readable. Evidence: source, focused scene/camera tests, launch commands, and captured frames from the actual renderer. Validation: independently launch the scene and exercise camera behavior; confirm real 3D rendering rather than a 2D imitation. This node does not stand in for input, combat, or destruction validation.
execution_limit: Only reproducible technical defects in renderer/camera; carry subjective judgments and crowded captures to node 9 for human playtest. Do not change mission state.
